## Design in one paragraph

Widen check 31 (`check_orphaned_per_unit_figures`) from the `per[-_]?(context|unit|cell|pair)` filename family to EVERY committed `figures/issue_<N>/*.png` at a body-cited SHA. Third WARN class `committed-figure-unmentioned` for the widened superset; classes A/B keep their tokens and their stricter paragraph-scoped phrase bar for exact names. A committed figure counts as "named" if its stem appears in the body verbatim OR is matched by a bounded backtick-quoted glob (basename component only, ≥3 literal chars before the `*`). Everything stays WARN-grade — no grandfathered body can be newly hard-FAILed. Nine new pins; the 20 pre-existing check-31 tests must stay byte-unmodified.

## Review record (2 rounds, both Claude `critic`, Methodology lens / infra mode)

**Round 1 → REVISE, 2 blockers, both real:**

1. Three of the required negative test fixtures were unconstructible. `_make_repo_with_per_unit_orphan` (`tests/test_verify_task_body.py:1312`) unconditionally commits `hero_percontext.png`, which fires class A regardless of the pin's subject — so the asserted `is_warn is False` was unreachable, including for the task body's own required negative fixture. Fixed by making the companion nullable and having each negative pin account for it.
2. **A real design defect, reproduced independently before the rewrite.** v1's exact-stem mention bar false-fires on glob-collective family dispositions. At #2061's cited SHA `5d001092…` there are 8 committed `f1_delta_scatter_*.png` files; the CORRECTED body embeds exactly one and dispositions the other seven collectively as ``the seven `f1_delta_scatter_*` siblings — **not embedded**`` (`tasks/reviewing/2061/body.md:61`). Under v1 the already-fixed body would emit 7 class-C WARNs — acceptance criterion (b) inverted. Verified by enumerating the tree at the SHA and testing each stem against the body: 7 of 8 ABSENT. Collective family disposition is also what the check-20 conciseness caps push bodies toward, so it is the common shape. Fixed by §3.1's bounded glob bar.

**Round 2 → PASS, 0 blockers**, with both round-1 fixes verified independently against the real artifacts (not taken on the plan's word): all 9 pins walked for fixture-reachability; the glob bar confirmed to silence all seven f1 siblings on the current body while still firing on `f5_arm_agreement.png` in the pre-fix body (`git show 93566d735f:tasks/interpreting/2061/body.md`, 0 hits vs HEAD's 1). Round 2 also probed the new v2 material — path-shaped globs, fence-spanning tokens, `?`/`[…]` metacharacters, Repro-footer command globs — and found no blanket escape and no wrongly-rejected legitimate disposition. All §2 ground-truth line numbers re-verified correct.

**v3** folds round 2's four advisory nits, all accuracy corrections to the plan rather than design changes. The load-bearing one: `fd182f8da8c6…` is NOT a cited figure SHA — it appears only inside HuggingFace `tree`/`blob` links, and `_cited_issue_figure_dirs` (`:2973-2986`) collects only raw-GitHub image URLs, so it never enters check 31's input. v2 had described it as a known-unreachable control, which would have sent an implementer chasing a phantom `n_unreachable == 1`.

## Disclosed behaviour change (not a silent one)

v2/v3 abandon v1's promise that classes A/B stay byte-identical. Extending the glob bar to the per-unit family moves a glob-named companion out of class A (which has no exemption path at all) into the class-B/phrase-bar branch. This is **loosening only** — strictly fewer and weaker WARNs, never a new WARN and never a FAIL — so it is safe under forward-only. Round 2 confirmed none of the founding incidents (#928 never-mentioned, #1426 exact-named-with-bare-provenance, #1510 phrase gating) relies on the removed WARN. Pinned in both directions by §5 test 9. The alternative — glob bar for class C only — was rejected as incoherent: one disposition sentence would exempt a body's `f1_*` figures but not its `f2_percell_*` figures.
